description: Create a copy of a channel, including its name, topic, and permission overwrites (but not its messages). Requires the Manage Channels permission, and View Channel on the source: the tool refuses a source the bot cannot view, whose overwrites Discord may replace with a single @everyone View Channel deny. Returns the cloned channel's name and ID.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel to clone.

new_name.description: Optional name for the clone. Defaults to the source channel's name.

name: discord_clone_channel
